solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Possibly a red bird flew off first

indicators.note: first says the departing word comes ahead of the bird in the answer

parts.note: flew off means departed, left
a winger, loosely, is something that wings its way through the air

explanation.surface: A red-coloured bird is seen to take flight before the others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly a red' looks like a description of the bird; it is the definition, a red being a socialist.
explanation.definitionFit: A red is a communist or socialist, an example of someone on the political left.

clue.text: Curl forward

definitions.meaning: a curl of hair is a tress
in rugby union a second-row forward has this name

explanation.walkthrough: In rugby union the second-row forwards are known by this name.
explanation.definitionFit: A tress of hair and a rugby second-row forward share this word.

clue.text: Punishment holding African party back

indicators.note: holding says the punishment contains the party

parts.note: a fine is a monetary punishment
the ANC is the African National Congress, South Africa's governing party

explanation.surface: A penalty restrains an African political party from going ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' looks like a reversal signal, but it is the definition, a verb meaning to fund.
explanation.definitionFit: To back a venture is to fund it, provide money for it.

clue.text: Canary below cuckoo captured by artist

indicators.note: captured by says the jumbled word goes inside the artist

parts.note: James McNeill Whistler was an American painter

indicators.note: cuckoo means crazy, so the letters of below go wild

explanation.surface: A canary under a cuckoo is caught by a painter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cuckoo' rearranges BELOW into BLOWE. A canary is slang for an informer, one who sings to the police.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang canary is an informer who sings, like someone exposing wrongdoing.

clue.text: Missing summit, wing enters warmer rising cloud

indicators.note: enters says the trimmed wing goes inside
rising in a down clue says the warmer is read upwards, reversed

parts.note: the sun is what warms us

indicators.note: missing summit says the top letter of the wing word is dropped

parts.note: a limb, like a wing, is a projecting part

explanation.surface: A cloud rises warmly and a wing enters it, missing the mountain top.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Missing summit' cuts LIMB to IMB; 'rising' turns SUN into NUS.
explanation.definitionFit: A rain-bearing grey cloud layer has this meteorological name.

clue.text: Blooming thing cutting through Cambridgeshire city, wind

indicators.note: cutting through says the flower goes inside the city

parts.note: Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire, England
an aster is a flowering plant

explanation.surface: A flower blows through a Cambridgeshire city in the wind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blooming' looks like a mild British oath but means flowering here.
explanation.definitionFit: A wind from the east is named for its direction.

clue.text: Search for food

definitions.meaning: to ... about is to search by digging or rummaging

explanation.definitionFit: Rummaging in soil and slang for a meal share the one short word.

clue.text: Pack forcibly split defence

parts.note: to ram is to cram or pack forcibly
to part is to split

explanation.surface: A pack forcing its way breaks open the defences.
explanation.definitionFit: A defensive wall or embankment around a castle protects it.

clue.text: Commercial breaks charm quiet nation

indicators.note: breaks says the commercial cuts into the charm

parts.note: a bangle is a bracelet, a charm being a trinket on such jewellery
an ad is a commercial
sh is a call for quiet

explanation.surface: An advertisement interrupts a quiet, charming country.
explanation.definitionFit: A South Asian republic, once East Pakistan, is a country.

clue.text: Artifice hard to prove

parts.note: a con is a trick, an artifice
firm means hard, solid

explanation.surface: A clever trick that is difficult to demonstrate.
explanation.definitionFit: To prove a claim is to establish or verify that it is true, a straight synonym.

clue.text: He built the Temple of Jerusalem unassisted, the first of seven?

definitions.text: He built the Temple of Jerusalem

parts.note: doing something solo is doing it unassisted
Mon, short for Monday, is the first of the seven days of the week

explanation.surface: The king built the Temple alone, the first of seven such wonders?
explanation.walkthrough: The query flags that the seven are days of the week, with Monday taken as their first.
explanation.definitionFit: The Bible says King David's son, the wise king of Israel, built the First Temple.

clue.text: Battle scene, blasted thing of oxymoronic proportions?

definitions.meaning: the site of Custer's Last Stand in 1876 Montana
a blown horn described as both small and large at once

explanation.definitionFit: Custer's defeat took place on a Montana river whose name contradicts itself in size.

clue.text: Triangle perhaps, popular shape men trust

parts.note: in means popular, fashionable

indicators.note: to shape something is to mould it into a new form, so the letters of men trust are rearranged

explanation.surface: A fashionable triangular figure that men can rely on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shape' rearranges MENTRUST into STRUMENT. 'Triangle' suggests geometry, but it is the percussion piece.
explanation.definitionFit: The triangle is a percussion device in the orchestra, an example of something played.

clue.text: Trouble in parliament from the right

indicators.note: from the right says the hidden letters are read leftwards, backwards
in says the letters sit within the word parliament

explanation.surface: Difficulties in the House coming from the right-wing benches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' finds LIA inside parliament; 'from the right' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: To ail is to trouble or afflict someone, as an illness does.

clue.text: In a rage, having stubbed one's toe?

definitions.meaning: someone who has hurt a toe jumps on one foot in anger

explanation.definitionFit: Furious anger and leaping about on one foot after hurting it are both pictured.

clue.text: First man in is key?

definitions.meaning: in cricket the first batsman in is an opening batsman
a key is something that unlocks a door or puzzle

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an opening batsman is the first to go in to bat.
explanation.definitionFit: An opening batsman in cricket and a tool that unlocks share this word.

clue.text: Date ruined by something remarkable backfiring, howled in grief

indicators.note: by places the turned-round remarkable thing beside the wrecked date
backfiring suggests going the wrong way, so the remarkable thing is read backwards

parts.note: a lulu is something outstanding or remarkable

indicators.note: ruined says the letters of date are wrecked and rearranged

explanation.surface: A date was spoiled by something extraordinary going wrong, and someone wailed with grief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backfiring' turns LULU into ULUL; 'ruined' rearranges DATE into ATED.
explanation.definitionFit: To ululate is to wail or howl, especially in lamentation.

clue.text: Girl hiding drink in pouches

indicators.note: hiding says the girl conceals the drink inside

parts.note: Maria is a girl's name
to sup is to drink

explanation.surface: A girl hides a drink in her pockets.
explanation.definitionFit: Kangaroos carry young in abdominal pouches, the plural of the Latin term.

clue.text: Poorly individual

definitions.meaning: feeling odd is feeling a little unwell, poorly
individual means distinctive, belonging to one only

explanation.definitionFit: Feeling queer or unwell, and distinctive or particular, are both senses of the word.

clue.text: Staff investing money, foreign capital

indicators.note: investing in the sense of clothing, so the staff wraps around the money

parts.note: a cane is a walking staff
the yen is Japanese money

explanation.surface: Staff investing money in foreign capital markets.
explanation.walkthrough: 'investing' and 'capital' suggest finance; the capital is a city.
explanation.definitionFit: The chief city of French Guiana in South America is its capital.

clue.text: A church removed from god, you can count on it!

indicators.note: removed from says the church letters are taken out of the god

parts.note: Bacchus is the Roman god of wine

explanation.surface: A church that has lost its god: here is something you can rely on.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on 'count on it' meaning rely on it, when a frame of beads is literally counted on.
explanation.definitionFit: A frame of sliding beads is used for counting and arithmetic, so one literally counts on it.

clue.text: Miss in competition — still not far off?

indicators.note: in says the miss goes inside the competition

parts.note: a cup is a competition, as in the FA Cup
to lose is to miss out

explanation.surface: Missing out in a competition but still not far away?
explanation.walkthrough: 'still' looks like an adverb meaning yet; it is a noun, a photograph.
explanation.definitionFit: A photograph taken at very short range is a still not far away.

clue.text: African ruminant, little one repeatedly climbing

indicators.note: repeatedly says the reversed child appears twice
climbing in a down clue says the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a kid is a little one, a child

explanation.surface: An African animal with a little one keeps climbing.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiny antelope of East and southern Africa chews the cud.

clue.text: Boston Tea Party ends, indeed

indicators.note: ends picks the final letter of each of the three words

explanation.surface: The Boston Tea Party ends, it truly does.
explanation.definitionFit: Nay is an old word used to intensify, meaning indeed or more than that.

clue.text: Dirty linen not to be written about in seat of government

parts.note: dirty linen is washing waiting to be done

indicators.note: written about says the word not is set down turned about, backwards

explanation.surface: Scandalous private matters must not be reported in Parliament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dirty linen' hints at scandal but is literal laundry.
explanation.definitionFit: The US capital is where the federal government sits.

clue.text: French city that's transparent

definitions.meaning: a city in the Pas-de-Calais in northern France
a piece of transparent glass used in optics

explanation.definitionFit: A northern French town and a clear optical glass share the four letters.

clue.text: Catcher some briefly call back

indicators.note: back says the whole is read in reverse

parts.note: part means some, a portion

indicators.note: briefly says the word is cut short, losing its final letter

parts.note: to name is to call

explanation.surface: A catcher in some brief telephone call returned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'briefly' drops the last letter of the call word, and 'back' turns the whole lot round; 'Catcher' suggests baseball but is a snare.
explanation.definitionFit: A trap for catching intruders or poachers is something that snares people.

clue.text: See GP bandaging middle of joint, then see fractures

indicators.note: then puts the broken see after the doctor
bandaging says the doctor wraps around the letter from the joint

parts.note: a GP, a general practitioner, is a doctor, a doc

indicators.note: middle of picks the central letter of joint
fractures says the letters of see are broken and rearranged

explanation.surface: A doctor bandages a joint, then sees the fractures.
explanation.walkthrough: 'middle of joint' gives I; 'fractures' rearranges the second see into ESE. The first 'See' is the definition, a bishop's district, not the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: A bishop's see is the district under his authority, the crossword sense of see.

clue.text: Document that may be sent back unchanged

definitions.note: a legal paper such as a title to property is a document of this kind

indicators.text: that may be sent back unchanged
indicators.note: sent back unchanged says the word reads the same reversed

parts.note: a legal paper such as a title to property is a document of this kind

explanation.surface: A document that could be returned without alteration.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal instrument conveying property is a signed document.

clue.text: Cheeky child, a scruff, lifts clothing

indicators.note: clothing says the lifts wrap around, dress, the rest

parts.note: jacks are devices that lift cars
the scruff is the nape of the neck

explanation.surface: A cheeky, scruffy child pinches clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'clothing' looks like garments but is the containment signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An impertinent or mischievous youngster is called this, like a monkey.
